children.name: Why are air changes per hour (ACH) important when shopping for an air purifier?
children.characters: Why should I choose Good Chop?

children.name: Air changes per hour (ACH) refers to how many times the air is changed with new, clean air in a given space within the span of an hour. A Harvard University Study cited by the CDC recommends at least 4 air changes per hour to effectively remove allergens like smoke, bacteria, viruses, dust, and pollen.
children.characters: All our meats are domestic, born, bred and raised right here in the USA. And our fish is wild caught off US coasts or sustainably raised in US farms. The quality of our steaks matches some of the best steakhouses of the country, while the taste and sustainability of our fish is better than what you can find in most seafood restaurants. With over 80 carefully selected products, we offer one of the widest selection of meats and seafood, and the best thing is that you can fully customize your box as you see fit. Our products are all natural, free of artificial ingredients and preservatives, and minimally processed.  Some of our most popular products include: USDA Choice ribeyes, thick-cut uncured bacon, chicken breasts, wild-caught Alaskan salmon, porterhouse steak, lamb chops, crab legs.
